news.title: Indo Borax & Chemicals Limited Announces Resignation of Saurnya Sajal Jain as Chief Executive Officer, Effective January 23, 2026
news.body: Indo Borax & Chemicals Limited announced that Mr. Saurnya Sajal Jain has tendered his resignation as the chief executive officer of the Company on January 23, 2026, effective immediately on the delivery of the resignation letter, which was taken on record by the Board in its meeting on January 23, 2026. Consequently, he has ceased to hold any positions in the Company, including that of key managerial personnel of the Company, with effect from the delivery of the resignation letter. Resignation was resulted  as part of the board reorganization consequent to the change in control of the Company in terms of the share purchase agreement dated December 15, 2025.

news.title: Indo Borax & Chemicals Limited Announces Board and Committee Changes, Effective January 23, 2026
news.body: Indo Borax & Chemicals Limited announced that Mr. Sajal Jain (DIN: 00314855) has tendered his resignation as the managing director of the Company on January 23, 2026, effective immediately on the delivery of the resignation letter, which was taken on record by the Board in its meeting held on January 23, 2026. Consequently, he has ceased to be a key managerial personnel of the Company and member of all committees and positions in the Company, including the audit committee and corporate social responsibility committee of the Board, with effect from the delivery of the resignation letter. news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹2.89 (vs ₹2.83 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹2.89 (up from ₹2.83 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹453.5m (up 21% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹92.7m (up 2.2% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 20% (down from 24% in 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 4% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 25% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.
